items.name: GPQA-D
items.description: A display-only GPQA Diamond reference from provider comparison charts.

items.name: MMLU-Pro
items.description: An enhanced version of MMLU with 10 answer choices instead of 4, featuring more reasoning-focused questions that better differentiate frontier models.

items.name: HLE
items.description: An expert-authored benchmark designed to probe frontier knowledge and reasoning. BenchLM keeps protocol differences visible because tool-assisted and closed-book HLE runs answer different questions.

items.name: GPQA Diamond (Vals)
items.description: Vals AI’s independent run of the GPQA Diamond graduate-level science questions.

items.name: HumanEval
items.description: HumanEval tests whether generated Python functions pass unit tests on 164 handwritten problems. These scores describe function-level correctness; they do not measure repository work or a coding agent.

items.name: SWE-bench Verified
items.description: SWE-bench Verified tests patches for 500 human-filtered GitHub issues. A score measures how many tasks an evaluated model-and-agent setup resolved; the model name alone does not identify that setup.

items.name: LiveCodeBench
items.description: A continuously updated coding benchmark built from newly collected LeetCode, AtCoder, and Codeforces problems. Fresh problem windows reduce one contamination path, but results still need a release and setup check.

items.name: ProgramBench
items.description: A cleanroom software-engineering benchmark where agents receive only a compiled executable and documentation, then must architect and implement a complete codebase that reproduces the original program's behavior.

items.name: SWE-bench (Vals)
items.description: Vals AI’s independent run of the public SWE-bench issue set, reported by human time-to-fix bucket. Vals removed SWE-bench Verified from its index as saturated on 2026-05-04; this board is the standalone SWE-bench run.

items.name: DeepSWE
items.format: Pass@1 with confidence interval, cost, time, and token metadata
items.description: A long-horizon software engineering benchmark from Datacurve for measuring frontier coding agents on original tasks drawn from active open-source repositories.

items.name: Apex
items.description: A high-difficulty mathematical reasoning benchmark reported in DeepSeek-V4 model evaluations.

items.name: ARC-AGI-1
items.description: ARC Prize fluid-intelligence benchmark using novel visual grid transformations.

items.name: LongBench v2
items.description: A long-context benchmark that measures whether models can actually use extended context windows for reasoning and retrieval.

items.name: MRCRv2
items.description: A long-context benchmark for memory, retrieval, and multi-round coherence over large contexts.

items.name: MRCR 1M
items.description: A million-token MRCR long-context retrieval benchmark reported in DeepSeek-V4 model evaluations.

items.name: Terminal-Bench 4.1
items.format: Task completion rate across 5 trials per task
items.description: The current Terminal-Bench release keeps the 66 professional computer-work tasks of 4.0 and regrades every saved trial with verifiers hardened against reward hacking and overly strict checks.

items.name: AA Briefcase
items.description: An independently evaluated professional-work benchmark reported as Elo.

items.name: BrowseComp
items.description: BrowseComp tests whether a browsing agent can find difficult, fact-seeking answers across the web. Its 1,266 problems use short answers that are easier to grade than an open-ended research report.

items.name: GDPval-AA
items.description: An agentic real-world work-task evaluation reported as an Elo score in DeepSeek-V4 thinking-mode evaluations.

items.name: AA Agentic Index
items.description: A display-only Artificial Analysis agentic index.

items.name: AutomationBench
items.description: An agent benchmark for completing automation workflows in reproducible task environments.

items.name: Agents' Last Exam
items.description: An agent benchmark reported in DeepSeek's V4 Flash 0731 launch comparison.

items.name: DeepSearchQA
items.description: An agentic browsing benchmark where models search the web, gather evidence, and answer list-style questions using browser tools.

items.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1 (Vals)
items.description: Vals AI’s independent run of the Terminal-Bench 2.1 terminal-task suite with published easy, medium, and hard splits.

items.name: Chartography (no tools)
items.description: Professional chart understanding across 100 specialized chart types with expert-set answer tolerances.

items.name: MMMU
items.description: A broad multimodal reasoning benchmark spanning charts, diagrams, tables, and academic visual question answering.

items.name: MMMU-Pro
items.description: A harder multimodal benchmark for frontier models that combines text with images, diagrams, charts, and academic visual reasoning tasks.

items.name: BabyVision
items.description: A multimodal benchmark for fine-grained visual perception and grounded reasoning tasks.
